name: Sonnet concentrated AI/technology
strategy: Concentrated long book in AI infrastructure leaders (compute, networking, memory) with leveraged semis beta for extra torque, a modest single-name short to offset gross exposure, and cash held for weekly rebalancing flexibility.

positions.thesis: Core AI compute bottleneck; Blackwell/next-gen ramp keeps NVDA the highest-quality way to own the capex cycle.
Azure AI monetization plus enterprise Copilot adoption gives durable, lower-volatility AI platform exposure.
Custom silicon/networking for hyperscaler AI clusters diversifies compute exposure beyond GPUs.
MI-series datacenter GPU share gains and cyclical semis exposure at a more reasonable multiple than NVDA.
HBM/memory remains structurally tight for AI servers; recent pullback after +187% H1 run is an entry, not a thesis break.
3x leveraged semis exposure to amplify the AI infrastructure cycle given high conviction in the sector.
Relative laggard in on-device/enterprise AI monetization versus platform peers; funds long book while staying within short-side limits.

outlook: AI capex cycle remains the dominant equity driver into year-end, though recent memory/optics froth needs digesting; crypto stays in a bear regime we're avoiding, and we keep a cash buffer for the Fed/earnings-driven volatility likely through Q3.
